halt_resolution: SEAM-A-only predicate `shouldFilterCompletionResult` added to SdkSessionEventCoordinatorOptions. Harness's mutable `c10FilterDecision` cell drives it without touching SEAM B's option-bag methods (hasActiveNotify / wasWakeDelivered / isWakeAuthoritySettled / getActiveNotifyCount unchanged). SEAM B reads REAL coordinator state regardless of SEAM A's filter switch.

framework_authority_barrier.effect: setTurnPhase('completed', ...) lifecycle commit refused when any notify-owned launched jobId has wake authority delivered. Deferred-completion-barrier marker is set. reevaluateDeferredCompletionBarrier() drains it once obligations resolve.

setup.rationale: SEAM A observes owned outstanding marker at emit (per-jid narrow; per the bounded correction criterion). SEAM B observes wasWakeDelivered=true (immutable historical state). The two layers see the same wake state but consult DIFFERENT predicates — isolating SEAM A from SEAM B.
